{{DISPLAYTITLE:Controls for ''GTA San Andreas''}}
This article lists the default controls used for ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]'' on the [[Personal Computer|PC]], [[Xbox (console)|Xbox]], and [[PlayStation 2|PS2]].

When playing on the [[Xbox 360]], White is LB and Black is RB; however, in the ''[[Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition|Definitive Edition]]'' for [[Xbox Series X and Series S|Xbox Series X|S]], White is LT and Black is RT.

On PC, the player can change the controls by clicking on ''Redefine Controls'' in the control-menu option and choose their own way to play.
